witness.quote: A vehicle otherwise lawfully parked in an alley shall not park for a greater period than thirty minutes within any one-hour period.
witness.reason: The alley parking task directly supports timed parking; entrance presence alone does not establish otherwise lawful parking.
required_context: Establish municipal jurisdiction and all supplied alley characteristics: public vehicular use within a city block, primary rear-property access, special accommodation of abutting property and absence of a cul-de-sac.
Establish municipal jurisdiction and all supplied alley-definition characteristics.
Locate the parking target relative to the entrance without assuming access obstruction.
Preserve unresolved incorporation of the supplied NRS definitions.
Record elapsed intervals, observation boundaries and available history for thirty minutes within any one-hour period; preserve unknown history and do not invent a reset rule.
Record parking history, departures, returns, purpose and loading activity.
Retain parking location, vehicle identity, motion, departures, returns, relocations, occupancy, purpose and actual loading activity.
Supply applicable parking rules and facts establishing otherwise lawful parking.
Supply applicable parking rules and facts supporting the otherwise-lawfully-parked prerequisite.
witness.subject_reason: The available motor_vehicle_driver can operate and park the vehicle to which the duration obligation attaches.
